method: Opened all 15 rendered slides individually, plus contact sheet; re-opened revised slides after layout/axis fixes. Unchanged final slides were verified by identical preview SHA256.

slides.observations: Editable native flow nodes, arrows and rolling boundary inset readable; single commit and conditional tag-only scope explicit.
All three producer-to-estimator-to-qualification lanes and six recording rows readable; process outcomes not called full trajectories.
Exactly three seeds and four distinct method styles; full/noFDE coincident scores and noncausal final view clearly separated.
R3 XY/height axes and separated legend intact; CAL, Walk reference and STAR gyro caveats visible, including 15.85 km frozen-interface result.
Coverage bars and original denominators agree; R3 FULL is NA; Walk rates are temporal and real raw PL remains unqualified.
Zero reference and all negative per-seed gains intact; black mean markers and separate attitude effects readable.
Full SFUISE outlier scale, hybrid APE scale, fault bands and actual prior/bridge/rejoined receipt markers readable.
Full/zoom horizontal Stanford axes intact; PE/PL diagonal, research ALs, late bins, N and non-independent risk caveat explicit.
Full/zoom vertical panels, all three healthy AL points and denominator table readable without overlap.

Complete axis labels, actual window curves, sampled-RSS bubbles and matched common-interval table readable; cost and fault benefit both visible. Fixed LF=300 / LI=30,100,300 note was re-opened and checked in the final render.
Core/sink line styles and exclusive-mean breakdown readable; main versus E06 repeat IDs and nominal-only capability separated.
All signed ablation cells, dark-cell labels, G2 NA and measured abort cost readable; M/A/P and combined switch distinguished.
FULL output ends at actual epoch7171 with blank suffix; high ARE, queue counts, refused epochs and nonconstant storage boundary visible.
All five evidence-to-claim rows and additional omitted metrics/studies readable; no hardware qualification claim.
All four complete advisor questions and requested decisions readable; final main slide is actionable discussion, not thank-you.
